steps.title: Autopilot card
steps.text: Drives the boat: modes, the mission, a gamepad and the action on link loss.

steps.title: Link and mode
steps.text: The icon is grey without an autopilot, teal while it is connected and red while the boat is armed. Next to it, the current mode.

steps.title: On link loss
steps.text: What the boat does if the link drops. Amber means it does nothing.

steps.title: Telemetry
steps.text: Battery, speed, link, satellites, voltage and current.

steps.title: Details
steps.text: Opens the details below. A tap on the left part of the card does the same.

steps.title: Arm
steps.text: Tap ARM, then tap again while the ring runs (3 s). An armed boat shows the button red; one tap disarms.

steps.title: Manual control
steps.text: Manual: the transmitter or the gamepad drives directly. Acro keeps the heading; tap it again to go back to Manual.

steps.title: Stop
steps.text: Hold stops the motors and the boat drifts. Loiter keeps the boat on its spot by GPS.

steps.title: Mission and return
steps.text: Auto runs the mission stored on the boat. RTL returns to the nearest rally point or home.

steps.title: Go here
steps.text: Turn it on, tap a point in the 3D view and confirm: the boat goes there.

steps.title: Parameters, planner, close
steps.text: All autopilot parameters, the mission planner and closing the card.

steps.title: Gamepad
steps.text: Take or release control from a gamepad. The A button takes control by itself once a gamepad and the boat are connected.

steps.title: Mission progress
steps.text: Point, distance and time left. A tap on the row opens the details.

steps.title: Boat
steps.text: GPS fix, distance to home, radio signal and firmware.

steps.title: Mission
steps.text: Current and next point, distance and cross-track error. Next point skips ahead after two taps; Read from the boat fetches the mission again.

steps.title: Speed
steps.text: Changes the mission speed on the go. ↺ returns to the plan speeds.

steps.title: Card settings
steps.text: Choose which buttons and panels the card shows, its size and opacity. Also in Settings → Interface → Autopilot card.

steps.title: On link loss
steps.text: What the boat does when the link drops; saved on the boat. Mission in Auto: keep going or abort.

steps.title: Messages
steps.text: Reports from the boat and the app. Critical ones pop up even with the card closed.

steps.title: That's all
steps.text: Run this tour again from here.
